highlights.title: Browsers Kosmos opens keep its keys out
highlights.line: The browser a Kosmos sign-in opens on Windows no longer starts with Kosmos's own keys in its environment.

highlights.title: A message to an agent is not lost to typing
highlights.line: If other text lands in an agent's box while Kosmos is typing a message to it, the message is kept and sent once the box is clear.

highlights.title: A company computer says whose it is
highlights.line: A company member's Kosmos names the company, lists what it reports and never sends, and says which AI providers are allowed.

highlights.title: A little more space in project rooms
highlights.line: Posts in a project room now have slightly more space between lines.

highlights.title: Long agent messages say what they are about
highlights.line: When a long message is saved to a file for an agent, its pane line now shows how it starts and its length.
